references.text: Moses repeats the prohibition against adding to or taking away from God's commands and emphasizes the importance of sticking exactly to what has been commanded.
Proverbs warns against adding anything to God's word, for then he will punish you and you will be found a liar.
Ecclesiastes confirms that God's work is perfect and that nothing can be added to or taken away from what he does.
Revelation gives a similar warning not to add to or take away from the words of prophecy, with serious consequences for anyone who does so.
Moses urges the people to be careful to do what the Lord has commanded, without turning aside to the right or to the left.
Joshua receives the same exhortation to keep the whole law without turning from it, either to the right or to the left.
